#001

ARIA progressbar nodes must have an accessible name

aria-progressbar-name  •  UF-00001
High axe Other WCAG wcag2a|wcag111|EN-301-549|EN-9.1.1.1 Level Review Axe automated finding
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Ensure every ARIA progressbar node has an accessible name

Location

DOM selector: iframe[height="581px;"] ._55yn | Ownership: third_party_embed | Actionability: third_party_controlled

Affected HTML 

<span class="img _55ym _55yn _55yo" aria-busy="true" role="progressbar" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuetext="Loading..."></span>

axe automated evidence 

Fix any of the following:
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute

axe description

Ensure every ARIA progressbar node has an accessible name

Recommended change

ARIA progressbar nodes must have an accessible name

Manual review

Required: Yes

No dedicated remediation template has yet been defined for this rule.

#002

aria-prohibited-attr  •  UF-00002
High axe ARIA WCAG 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value Level A Axe automated finding
View issue details and remediation

Location

Affected HTML

axe automated evidence 

Fix all of the following:

axe description

Ensure ARIA attributes are not prohibited for an element's role

Recommended change

Remove the prohibited ARIA attribute or correct the element's role and semantics.

#011

Text color contrast requires review

color-contrast  •  UF-00011
High axe Color contrast WCAG 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) Level AA Axe automated finding
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Insufficient contrast between text and its background can make content difficult to read for users with low vision or color-vision deficiencies.

Location

DOM selector: .desc > div:nth-child(1) | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<div style="padding-bottom:9px; font-weight:500; font-size:15px; color:#000; text-align:center;line-height:1.0;">The options to choose from when it comes to higher education in Bangladesh may seem many but few are on par in quality and history with Stamford.</div>

axe automated evidence 

Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 1.88 (foreground color: #000000, background color: #2b3d50, font size: 11.3pt (15px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

axe description

Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds

Recommended change

Check the computed foreground and background colors of the affected text. Normal-sized text should generally have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, while qualifying large text should generally have a ratio of at least 3:1.

Manual review

Required: Yes

axe returned this finding as incomplete when contrast could not be conclusively evaluated automatically. Background images, gradients, transparency, overlapping elements, or other rendered styling can require manual inspection.

#048

Image does not have an appropriate text alternative

image-alt  •  UF-00048
Critical axe Images WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content Level A Axe automated finding
View issue details and remediation

Why this matters

Users who cannot perceive the image may not receive the information or function communicated by it.

Location

DOM selector: div:nth-child(1) > div:nth-child(1) > img[data-u="image"][border="0"][data-events="auto"] | Ownership: page_content | Actionability: directly_reviewable

Affected HTML 

<img data-u="image" src="https://www.stamforduniversity.edu.bd/asset/img/website-cover--fina.jpg" class="lazy" style="z-index: 0; top: 0px; left: 0px; width: 1900px; height: 750px; position: absolute; display: block; max-width: 10000px;" border="0" data-events="auto" data-display="block">

axe automated evidence 

Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have an alt attribute
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute
  Element's default semantics were not overridden with role="none" or role="presentation"

axe description

Ensure <img> elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Manual review

Required: Yes

The correct alternative depends on the purpose and surrounding context of the image.

Screen-reader users may encounter a link without being told what it does or where it goes.

Location

axe automated evidence 

Fix all of the following:
  Element is in tab order and does not have accessible text

Fix any of the following:
  Element does not have text that is visible to screen readers
  aria-label attribute does not exist or is empty
  aria-labelledby attribute does not exist, references elements that do not exist or references elements that are empty
  Element has no title attribute

Replace placeholder text with wording that correctly reflects the real page context.

Methodology note: Automated accessibility testing can identify many important problems, but it cannot establish complete WCAG conformance. Context-dependent and incomplete findings require human review. Context-aware recommendations are produced by deterministic rules using extracted local page context and should be verified before implementation.
